amendments.text: (a) The wing flaps, their operating mechanisms, and their supporting structures must be designed for critical loads occurring in the flaps-extended flight conditions with the flaps in any position. However, if an automatic flap load limiting device is used, these components may be designed for the critical combinations of airspeed and flap position allowed by that device. (b) The effects of propeller slipstream, corresponding to takeoff power, must be taken into account at not less than 1.4 VS, where VS is the computed stalling speed with flaps fully retracted at the design weight. For the investigation of slipstream effects, the load factor may be assumed to be 1.0.

subject_group: Ailerons; Wing Flaps; and Special Devices
